content: Drools KIE Server: single POST /containers/instances/{id} endpoint takes a BatchExecutionCommand (lookup attr = KIE session id, required for stateless, optional for stateful). Commands: insert, fire-all-rules (with max + out-identifier), get-objects, retract, modify, query, set-global, dispose. Response = ServiceResponse wrapping execution-results (results key/value pairs + facts with fact handles). Stateless = created/disposed per request, fire-and-forget; stateful = persistent, accumulates facts across calls, must explicitly DisposeCommand. Per-command out-identifiers let callers retrieve specific facts/results. lookup selects among configured sessions.
